title: Sandstone break to sand
description: This project let player get sand from sandstone
body: Allow players to recycle sandstone back into sand. This feature helps players save resources and manage their inventory or chest space more efficiently. Instead of keeping large amounts of sandstone that may no longer be needed, players can convert it back into sand and reuse it for building, crafting, smelting glass, or other purposes. This makes sandstone more practical and gives players a simple way to recover materials while keeping storage cleaner and more organized.
